messages:
Maya R: quick question — instead of our usual deadline-driven coalesce, what if we try a slot-anchored packing model? idea: allocate deterministic "slots" that open on fixed boundaries and allow tiny requests to fill later slots without stalling the head batch.

Tom C: sounds interesting. how do you avoid slots being gamed by noisy tenants?

Maya R: two levers: soft isolation (probabilistic admission per tenant) + token-credit decay for heavy tenants. small requests get preferential placement in next two slots; large ones go to the long-fill lane.

Lia P: curious about KV cache affinity — if we move a small request into a later slot, do we risk cache warming penalties for the next-token path?

Maya R: good call. plan is to pin KV affinity to tenant session for N slots (configurable). if slot delay > threshold, trigger a microwarm (prefetch prefix) async.

Karan S: need a simple config prototype so we can run perf tests. can you sketch a config snippet?

Maya R: sure, rough proto:
```
slot_anchor:
  slot_ms: 8
  slots_ahead: 2
  max_fill_per_slot: 24
  isolation_mode: soft  # soft | strict
  kv_pin_slots: 4
  microwarm_threshold_ms: 20
```

Sasha M: metrics we should collect: p50/p95/p99 latency per slot, slot_fill_ratio, cross-tenant_skew, kv_miss_rate_post_delay, and tail-correlation (requests delayed -> downstream stalls).

Tom C: also measure fairness delta (latency variance between tenants) and cost impact (tokens/second served). would like a synthetic test with mixed tiny/large distribution to simulate chat + completion workloads.

Lia P: fallback behavior? if slot system becomes congested, do we revert to continuous batching?

Maya R: plan: bump to degraded mode that disables slot anchoring and reverts to greedy coalesce. we should expose a rolloff hysteresis param to avoid flip-flops.

Karan S: ops concerns: rollout needs safe toggles per region and per-pool. add metrics-backed auto-disable (e.g., if p99 > baseline*1.25 for 3m).

deploy-bot: deploy queued: feature/slot-anchored-packing -> staging at 2026-01-15T08:12:34Z :rocket:

Sasha M: experimental design idea: AB test anchored vs baseline on 10% traffic, track 2 weeks, surface regression alerts tied to quality evals too (parity on log-likelihood for completion tasks).

Tom C: one more thought — edge case: burst of hundreds tiny requests from single tenant could fill many future slots and starve others. need a per-tenant window cap and an admission token bucket that decays faster for bursts.

Maya R: yep will add per-tenant slot_quota and burst_decay_factor. i'll draft an RFC with diagrams and a small simulator next week.

Lia P: please include failure modes: KV skew, slot misalignment across multi-gpu hosts, and telemetry gaps. want clear runbook entries.

Maya R: will do. thanks all :thumbsup:
